title: Block shows Dessa, a speech-only model it is not releasing yet
friendlyTitle: Block has shown a speech-only voice model. You cannot download it yet.
summary: Block, the company behind Square and Cash App, has published Dessa, a full-duplex speech-to-speech model it says was trained from scratch on human conversation only, with no text and no pretrained model. Block says it runs locally on a MacBook Pro M4 Max or better, and that training used one NVIDIA GB200 NVL72. The public page is a set of recorded conversations and a call for a small group of AI safety researchers to get early access. It is not a download.
friendlySummary: Block, the company behind Square and Cash App, has published Dessa. It is a voice model that listens and talks at the same time. Block says it was trained only on people talking, with no text and no older model underneath. Block says it runs on a MacBook Pro M4 Max or better, and that training used one NVIDIA GB200 rack. The public page is recordings plus a request for a small group of safety researchers to try it first. There is no public download.
whyItMatters: If you want a voice assistant that hears a pause or a laugh without first turning you into text, this is a real research demo, not a product you can put on a phone today. Block's own page also says everything the model knows came from speech. That is a different tool from a model you ask for facts, code, or a calendar. Treat the 'most authentic ever' line as the lab's claim, not a result.
